events.name: Online Open Mic 2026
events.title: Online Open Mic
events.subtitle: ek lafz. ek awaaz. aur ek shaam.
events.description: Whether it is an unread poem, an untold personal story, raw melodies, or laughs from everyday life — our online stage is ready for your craft.
events.short_description: A curated digital open mic celebrating poetry, storytelling, comedy, and music.
events.venue_address: Google Meet link provided to confirmed attendees
events.payment_instructions: Pay ₹79 using any UPI app (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm). Enter UTR/Transaction ID and upload screenshot proof.

events.title: Adhure Musafir
